name: Cline
tagline: Autonomous open-source coding agent extension for VS Code that edits files, runs terminal commands, and uses local LLMs.
real_test_summary: Tested connecting Cline to a local Ollama endpoint inside VS Code for multi-file feature scaffolding. Safely asks permission before executing terminal commands or modifying files.
pros: Step-by-step approval workflow keeps local file and shell actions safe
Connects directly to Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible local server
Reads compiler errors and iterates automatically until builds pass
cons: Agentic tool-calling loops require capable 14B+ local models for reliability
Large context prompts increase token processing time on local hardware
